summary: Skyworks Solutions filed an 8-K reporting results of early participation in its exchange offers and consent solicitations for Qorvo's outstanding 4.375% Senior Notes due 2029 and 3.375% Senior Notes due 2031. The filing is an update to a previously disclosed exchange offer as part of a merger agreement. No terms (price, premium, close date) are stated in this filing. The company is the issuer offering to exchange its securities for Qorvo notes. The structural detail is that this relates to a merger integration step. Watch for final exchange results and merger closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on successful exchange and shareholder approvals.
